description: This file contains a test class for the ConfigDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It includes unit tests for methods like setValue(), getValue(), and getAllValues(), and uses PHPUnit framework conventions. The class extends KernelTestCase and interacts with the entity Config and ORM components, indicating it is a test source file that verifies the DAO layer functionality.
